description: This file defines the 'MenuService' class responsible for managing menu configuration and caching within the OrangeHRM core plugin. It provides methods for retrieving menu items, enabling/disabling menu entries, caching logic, and handling menu item hierarchies and activity status, leveraging traits and data access objects.

classes.name: MenuService
classes.description: Service class for handling menu-related operations, including retrieval, enabling/disabling menu items, managing cache, and building menu hierarchies.

methods.name: getMenuDao
methods.description: Lazy initializes and returns the MenuDao object used for database interactions related to menu items.

methods.name: getScreenPermissionService
methods.description: Lazy initializes and returns the ScreenPermissionService object used for permission checks on screens.

methods.name: enableModuleMenuItems
methods.description: Enables menu items for a specified module and optional menu titles, and clears relevant cache attributes.

methods.name: invalidateCachedMenuItems
methods.description: Removes menu-related cache attributes from the authenticated user object to force cache refresh.

methods.name: getDetailedSidePanelMenuItemsAlongWithCache
methods.description: Retrieves detailed side panel menu items, using cache if available, otherwise querying the database.

methods.name: getTopMenuItemsAlongWithCache
methods.description: Retrieves top menu items for a given side panel menu item ID, with caching based on user attributes.

methods.name: generateCacheKeyForTopMenuItem
methods.description: Generates a cache key string for top menu items related to a specific side panel menu item ID.

methods.name: getMenuItems
methods.description: Constructs and returns the main menu structure, including side panel and top ribbon menus, along with active states.

methods.name: getMenuItemChainForMenuItem
methods.description: Builds a chain of parent menu items from a given menu item up to the root.

methods.name: isActiveSidePanelMenuItem
methods.description: Determines if a side panel menu item is active based on current module and screen context or configuration.

methods.name: isActiveTopMenuItem
methods.description: Checks if a top menu item is active based on current module/screen context or configuration.

methods.name: normalizeMenuItem
methods.description: Normalizes a DetailedMenuItem object into a menu representation array, including URL and active status.

methods.name: normalizeTopMenuItem
methods.description: Recursively normalizes a top menu item and its children for rendering, filtering out irrelevant items.
